answer_1.quote: We propose LYRA, an unsupervised, hierarchical melody‑conditioned LYRics generAtor that can generate high-quality lyrics ...
datasets: manually collected 20 copyrighted songs and 14 public songs from MuseScore

answer_2.quote: We automatically assess the generated lyrics on two aspects: the quality of text and music alignment. For text quality, we divide it into 3 subaspects: Topic Relevance, Diversity, Fluency... We also compute the ratio of cropped sentences among all sentences to assess how well they fit music phrase segments. For music alignment, we compute the percentage where the stress‑duration rule holds.

answer_4.quote: We used qualification tasks to recruit 120 qualified annotators... Each piece of music was annotated by at least three workers, who were asked to evaluate the quality of the lyrics using a 1‑5 Likert scale on six dimensions across musicality and text quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated the generated lyrics on six criteria (singability, intelligibility, coherence, creativeness, rhyme, overall quality) using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
